title: GPP Sprint Plan for Big Guys
desc: Hybrid training will not get you the results you want. You need to specialize if you want to move the needle. Train like a sprinter for 1 or 2 meso cycles.

ex.note: 4-6 reps x Accel Line Drill - 14-16 strides

ss.note:
3-5 sets, 3-4 sprints of 20-30m per set. 1-2min rest between reps. 
3-4min rest between sets.

ex.note:
2-3 rounds of FWD&BKWD low walks 15-20m
Resisted low walks 15-20m
Lateral low walks 15-20m

5 sets of 3 reps 100m sprints
Should take about 16 sec. 1min rest between reps. 
3min rest between sets. 
smooth, relaxed mechanics

Long lunge: 4-6 sets of 2-3 reps. 2-3min rest between sets. 

Short lunge: 2-4 sets of 2-3 reps. 2-3min rest between sets.

2–3 sets x 5 reps
	•	Cue: tall posture, minimal ground time

2–3 rounds each of:
	•	RRR… (Right leg only bounds)
	•	RLRL… (Alternating leg bounds)
	•	RRLL… (Right x2, Left x2 pattern)

2–3 sets each direction
Forward hops
Lateral hops
Medial hops
Use 6–12” hurdles

Short Hill Sprints
5 sets × 5–8 reps of 9 sec hill sprints
Rest: Walk down between reps (~1:00), 3–4:00 between sets

5–10 reps × 20 sec hills
Rest: Walk down between reps, 3–4:00 set rest

5–8 × 20–30m sled sprints
Rest: 1–3:00 between reps
Load: ~10–15% of bodyweight
4-6 reps x Accel Line Drill - 14-16 strides
